title: phlegmariurus oceanianus
intro: Phlegmariurus oceanianus, commonly known as the New Zealand forked climbing fern, is a species of plant in the family Lycopodiaceae. It is a type of lycopod, a group of vascular plants that are known for their ability to thrive in diverse environments. The New Zealand forked climbing fern has been traditionally used for its health benefits, including the treatment of fever, rheumatism, and other inflammatory conditions, due to its therapeutic actions, such as anti-inflammatory and antipyretic properties. The plant contains bioactive constituents, including lignans and terpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties, although further research is needed to fully understand its potential health benefits.
